test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) AW-VP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83e0fafb922d01c7e3aee72e5db4ba831882ad859ae42a778ab96710090d5617.png] 

Option 2) KO-WA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c470ef9ebde88e49662e6d65e91fd2806413aad3c14875e0c65c17e31f98745b.png] 

Option 3) BX-WQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dc551b80ec1a18b99ee9c19082311e33d94865aba5907b81780bf23dc2ad83d.png] 

Option 4) TP-OI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42af5b105e095a10dde155bfa6e2ea188b11a1d5cece49fc877d818ebdacd141.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'KO-WA' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer
